title: Skydive Vancouver

services.name: Learn to Skydive
services.desc: Skydive Vancouver welcomes skydivers of all levels and disciplines, our friendly staff and skydiving friends will make you feel at home. With 2 Turbine aircraft, we are active daily up to 12,500′. We also host other events like Safety Day, Cinco de Mayo, Keen to Lean, BombShell Boogie, NorthWestBoogie, Bradley Meyer Wing Suit and more. We have been operating for over 48 years in the Abbotsford valley and welcome all

services.name: Tandem
services.desc: A First Jump Tandem Skydive is the easiest and most enjoyable introduction to skydiving available. After a short briefing you and your professional and experienced Instructor will take to the skies. After a 15-minute scenic flight, with stunning views of the north shore snowcapped mountains, rivers and lakes, all the way to downtown Vancouver and the Gulf Islands you will experience the freedom of human flight at free fall speeds of over 200KPH, followed by the quiet serenity of a surreal canopy descent.
